page.title: Start measuring
page.intro: Create your professional account and get every Stress Index feature for 60 days, no strings attached.
page.calloutBody: Full app access, unlimited client CRM, professional PDF reports and all 24 HRV parameters. No credit card required.

confirm.title: Welcome to Stress Index
confirm.intro: Your account has been created. You have 60 days of full access to every feature.
confirm.step1Body: We sent you a confirmation email: open the link to activate your account.
confirm.step2Body: Install Stress Index on your smartphone or tablet.
confirm.step3Body: Sign in with the credentials you just created and pair your Polar H10 (or another compatible ECG sensor) over Bluetooth to take your first measurements.
